item.title: New Legal Rights Proposed to Strengthen Support for Kinship Carers
item.description: Proposed changes to Scottish legislation aim to strengthen the legal rights of kinship carers by introducing a clear entitlement to needs based assessments, helping families access consistent financial, practical and advocacy support in line with The Promise.The post New Legal Rights Proposed to Strengthen Support for Kinship Carers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scots Placed at Heart of Ambitious Plan for Nature Recovery
item.description: NatureScot has published a new four year plan placing people at the heart of nature recovery in Scotland, outlining bold actions to halt biodiversity loss, tackle climate change, and deliver health, economic and environmental benefits for communities across the country.The post Scots Placed at Heart of Ambitious Plan for Nature Recovery appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Caithness Campaigner Challenges Criticism of Maternity Campaign Group
item.description: A Caithness mother and campaigner has issued a detailed right of reply after criticism of local maternity campaigners, setting out her own experiences of giving birth and defending the role of community groups in the ongoing debate.The post Caithness Campaigner Challenges Criticism of Maternity Campaign Group appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ardersier MP Seeks Clarity From Prime Minister Over Mingyang Investment
item.description: An Ardersier MP has urged the Prime Minister to provide clarity on the delayed Mingyang investment, warning that uncertainty over the £1.5 billion project and 1,500 jobs risks further damage to Scotland’s energy sector and the wider economy.The post Ardersier MP Seeks Clarity From Prime Minister Over Mingyang Investment appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: National Lottery Funding Moves Grant Lodge Redevelopment Forward
item.description: National Lottery funding has helped move plans forward to restore Elgin’s historic Grant Lodge, with Moray Council awarded £212,427 to develop proposals that could see the landmark reopened as a new heritage, tourism and learning hub at the heart of the town.The post National Lottery Funding Moves Grant Lodge Redevelopment Forward appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A First Floor Home Looking Out Across Mallaig Bay
item.description: Set along East Bay in Mallaig, this first floor flat enjoys open views across the harbour and towards the Small Isles, offering practical coastal living at the heart of a working west coast village with strong transport links.The post A First Floor Home Looking Out Across Mallaig Bay appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Presses Starmer to Strip Mandelson of Titles and Publish all Files
item.description: The SNP has renewed calls for the Prime Minister to strip Peter Mandelson of his titles and pension and publish all related documents, warning that any attempt to withhold information would further erode public trust.The post SNP Presses Starmer to Strip Mandelson of Titles and Publish all Files appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Change Proposed to Automatic Release Point for Short Term Prisoners
item.description: The Scottish Government has proposed reducing the automatic release point for certain short term prisoners from 40% to 30% of their sentence, as Justice Secretary Angela Constance sets out further measures to ease pressure on Scotland’s prison system while excluding domestic abuse and sexual offences.The post Change Proposed to Automatic Release Point for Short Term Prisoners appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Construction Ramps Up on A9 as Tay Crossing to Ballinluig Enters New Phase
item.description: Construction is ramping up on the A9 as the Tay Crossing to Ballinluig section enters full build, with 11 miles now under construction, new jobs and apprenticeships being created, and the Scottish Government setting out a clear path to full dualling between Perth and Inverness by 2035.The post Construction Ramps Up on A9 as Tay Crossing to Ballinluig Enters New Phase appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Belford Hospital Progress Welcomed as Concerns Raised Over Centralisation of Services
item.description: Plans for a new Belford Hospital building in Fort William have moved forward ahead of a public unveiling of designs, as an SNP candidate welcomes progress while warning that local health services across the Highlands must be protected from further centralisation.The post Belford Hospital Progress Welcomed as Concerns Raised Over Centralisation of Services appeared first on The Highland Times.
